note: BRK-03 tripped on earth fault and failed to reclose. Barakar Bazaar section out.
MHS-07 tripped on overcurrent. Mohishila section out.
KLT-02 tripped after cascading faults on the Kulti trunk.
STP-05 out. Sitarampur laterals lost supply.
SRN-01 tripped. Srishti Nagar section out.
Peak consumers without supply confirmed at 17,790 across five feeders.
MHS-07 restored after the faulted section was isolated at the Mohishila sectionaliser.
Outage management system link to the Neamatpur RTU lost. Consumer counts are not recorded from this point.
Outage management system link restored after 3 hours 45 minutes. Counts resume.
First consumer count after the outage management system link was restored.
BRK-03 re-energised after pole replacement near the Barakar level crossing.
SRN-01 restored. Srishti Nagar back on supply.
KLT-02 restored to the Kulti trunk. Sitarampur laterals remain out.
Remaining outages are individual service connections on the Sitarampur laterals.
STP-05 laterals energised after transformer replacement at Sitarampur.
